mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the oracle divinity of Yorubaland."
Orunmila is the oracle divinity of Yorubaland.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means total obedience to a powerful authority."
Morality in the African context means total obedience to a powerful authority.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the law which defines the rights and duties of individuals."
Civil law refers to the law which defines the rights and duties of individuals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the same thing as the principles of morality, the moral law or the natural law or the law of God."
Moral law to some people is the same thing as the principles of morality, the moral law or the natural law or the law of God.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the same thing as civil law."
Common law is the same thing as civil law.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the one that is informed and guided by social condition, education as well as family ties."
Natural conscience is the one that is informed and guided by social condition, education as well as family ties.
fib: ______ is one of the methods of moral teaching and learning religious education.
Dramatization is one of the methods of moral teaching and learning religious education.
______ is the judgement of conscience before the course of action has been taken.
Antecedent conscience is the judgement of conscience before the course of action has been taken.
______ refers to the law that governs the relationship between individuals and the state government.
Public law refers to the law that governs the relationship between individuals and the state government.
______ are the same throughout the whole world.
Moral rules are the same throughout the whole world.
______ is a place where relevant information concerning religions or education generally can be gathered.
A resource centre is a place where relevant information concerning religions or education generally can be gathered.
______ means a state law: a law operating internally within a country while international law refers to the rule and morals that regulate the relationship between the nations of the world.
Municipal law means a state law: a law operating internally within a country while international law refers to the rule and morals that regulate the relationship between the nations of the world.
